notablePrerequisites: Stalactite Dagger on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Samut and another legendary creature if desired.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping the targeted creature(s).
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.
